description: Puts out a phasor running at the slope of the one patched in, but resettable on its own, so two sequencers can run at one speed and be restarted separately

params.text: Sets the point in the cycle the output jumps to when a reset arrives; the knob's range covers one whole cycle either way
Attenuverts the reset phase CV input, -1 to +1
Press to jump the output to the reset phase

inputs.text: The phasor to follow; the output tracks its slope
A rising edge jumps the output to the reset phase

outputs.text: A 0-10V phasor at the slope of the input, restarting only on this module's own reset

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
